questions.question: Which famous oracle of the ancient world was known for its prophecies and was located in Greece?
questions.explanation: The Oracle of Delphi was one of the most famous oracles of the ancient Greek world and played a central role in Greek mythology and religion. It was known for its prophecies delivered by the priestess Pythia and attracted many pilgrims seeking advice.

questions.question: What describes the phenomenon of electrical conductivity in solids?
choices: A: The ability to conduct electrical current.
B: The ability to store heat.
C: The ability to generate magnetic fields.
D: The ability to reflect light.
questions.explanation: Electrical conductivity describes how well a material can conduct electrical current. This is particularly important in solid-state physics, as different materials exhibit varying conductivities influenced by their atomic structure.

questions.question: Was beschreibt das Phänomen der elektrischen Leitfähigkeit in Festkörpern?
choices: A: Die Fähigkeit, elektrischen Strom zu leiten.
B: Die Fähigkeit, Wärme zu speichern.
C: Die Fähigkeit, magnetische Felder zu erzeugen.
D: Die Fähigkeit, Licht zu reflektieren.
questions.explanation: Die elektrische Leitfähigkeit beschreibt, wie gut ein Material elektrischen Strom leiten kann. Dies ist besonders wichtig in der Festkörperphysik, da unterschiedliche Materialien variierende Leitfähigkeiten aufweisen, die durch ihre atomare Struktur beeinflusst werden.
